newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi businessman plans to set up an educational complex in Mecca at a cost of 20 million riyals.
- Saudi businessmen to seek new markets for Saudi products in Japan.
- Saudi Arabia's Real Estate fund to extend new 1,959 loans worth 536 million riyals.
- Saudi Cairo Bank posts 165 million riyal net profit in the first nine months of 1996.
- Saudi farmers air their grievances over the marketing of their products, call for the setting up of an agricultural marketing company.
- Saudi commerce minister highlights efforts to stabilise market price, warns traders who cause price hike in the market that they face punishment.
- Saudi Hollandi Bank posts a 117.3 million riyal net profit in the first nine months of 1996.
